The Chinese characters for Cameron

As a transliteration, Cameron is usually written 卡梅伦 (Kǎ méi lún). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Cameron comes from Scottish and means “crooked nose”.

About the name Cameron

A Scottish clan surname that became a popular first name for any gender.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Cameron suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
